annotations.title: Retry bank matching for a period

description:
Ask Well to look again for the bank payment behind a fiscal period's invoices that are marked paid with no confirmed bank payment, now. The automatic pass looks again at an invoice only when new bank activity arrives, so do not wait for it. Call it when `well_list_period_unmatched_invoices` shows `unmatched_count` above 0 for the period and the user asked to fix the gaps.

It takes the period only. Well picks the invoices on its side, from the period's unmatched invoices (at most 20 per call, in a fixed order); you never pass invoice ids. An invoice whose matching is already queued or running is skipped, so a repeat call while it runs adds nothing; call it once per ask.

The call itself books nothing. It only queues the matching, so it returns before any match lands: never say the gap is fixed. A match the matcher confirms later posts its payment journal like any automatic match, so do not tell the user that nothing will be posted. Say Well is looking again for `enqueued_invoice_ids`, and name each `skipped` invoice with its reason (`not_found`, `already_matched`, `already_queued`, `dispatch_failed`). `not_attempted_count` is the part of the period's unmatched invoices this call did not send. This call does not retry them, and the automatic pass re-checks them only when new bank activity arrives: do not tell the user they are covered. Read the period again later to see what matched.

Take `fiscal_year` and `fiscal_period` from a `well_list_period_unmatched_invoices` or `well_list_periods` entry; never derive them from a calendar month yourself.

**`success: false` means nothing was sent.** Never report a failed call as a retry in progress.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no other tool call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the period.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_retry_period_matching

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.
